title: Savings goals
description: Set savings goals and put dollars aside toward each one in a held balance.
goal_template: A savings goals app. Customers open a dollar balance, create goals with a name, a target amount and a date, add money toward a goal from their bank account, and see each goal's progress. Show the amount and any fee before each transfer, and every document the product requires before the customer agrees.

screens.title: Goals
screens.purpose: Each goal with its target, date and progress, from the balance the product holds and the lifecycle events api/ receives.

screens.title: New goal
screens.purpose: Name a goal, its target and its date. The goal's details are saved to Mynt's vault (saveFields) after consent, never to the app's own database.

screens.title: Open a balance
screens.purpose: Opening the dollar balance the goals draw on: the product's journey, with its consents, documents and the provider's hosted identity checks.

screens.title: Add to a goal
screens.purpose: Add dollars from the customer's bank account toward a goal: amount and fee shown first, then the provider's hosted flow.

flows.title: Create the first goal
steps: open the balance with the product's journey if the customer has none
ask for consent, then save the goal's name, target and date with saveFields
show the goal with no progress yet and an Add money button

flows.title: Add money to a goal
steps: show the amount and the fee
start the provider's hosted funding flow (startAction) and send the customer to its redirect_url
api/ records the outcome from Mynt's webhook (verifyWebhook); the goal's progress updates
